تستغرقوا (form X)
# تَسْتَغْرِقُوا (tastaḡriqū) /tas.taɣ.ri.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْرَقَ (istaḡraqa)
# تُسْتَغْرَقُوا (tustaḡraqū) /tus.taɣ.ra.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْرَقَ (istaḡraqa)
